Execution Notes:

1 second pause at the bottom of each rep while maintaining tension on the pecs

Protocol Details:

  • Rest: 3-5 min
  • Warm-up Sets: 2-3

Substitution Options:

  • Dumbbell Incline Bench Press
  • Lever Incline Bench Press

Execution Notes:

Do one set with low cable position, one set with medium-height cable position, and one height with a high cable position. If you only have one or two sets, choose the one or two cable positions you prefer.

Protocol Details:

  • Rest: 1-2 min
  • Warm-up Sets: 1-2

Substitution Options:

  • Lever Pec Deck Fly
  • Dumbbell Fly

Execution Notes:

1.5x shoulder width overhand grip. Slow 2-3 second negative. Feel your lats pulling apart on the way down.

Protocol Details:

  • Rest: 2-3 min
  • Warm-up Sets: 1-2

Substitution Options:

  • Cable Pulldown
  • Cable Parallel Grip Pulldown

Execution Notes:

Focus on squeezing your lateral delt to move the weight.

Protocol Details:

  • Rest: 1-2 min
  • Warm-up Sets: 1-2

Substitution Options:

  • High-Cable Cuffed Lateral Raise
  • Lean-In Dumbbell Lateral Raise

Execution Notes:

Stand on a bumper plate. Focus on getting a big stretch and touch your stomach/chest on each rep!

Protocol Details:

  • Rest: 2-3 min
  • Warm-up Sets: 1-2

Substitution Options:

  • Smith Bent-over Row
  • Dumbbell Bent-over Row

Execution Notes:

Optionally pause for 0.5-1 second in the stretched aspect of each rep

Protocol Details:

  • Rest: 1-2 min
  • Warm-up Sets: 1

Substitution Options:

  • Cable Triceps Extension (with rope)
  • Dumbbell Lying Triceps Extension

Execution Notes:

If you have a left-right bicep size imbalance, do these 1 arm at a time, starting with the weaker arm. Take the weaker arm to the listed RPE. Then match the reps with the other arm (stop once you've matched the reps, even if the RPE is lower). If you don't have a size imbalance, do these both arms at the same time.

Protocol Details:

  • Rest: 1-2 min
  • Warm-up Sets: 1

Substitution Options:

  • Seated Bayesian Cable Curl
  • Dumbbell Incline Curl

Execution Notes:

Set the machine so that you get the biggest stretch possible at the bottom. Prevent your butt from popping up as you curl.

Protocol Details:

  • Rest: 1-2 min
  • Warm-up Sets: 2

Substitution Options:

  • Lever Seated Leg Curl
  • Nordic Ham Curl

Execution Notes:

Once you are under the bar, set up your feet as you would a normal squat and then bring them forward 3-6 inches. This will cause you to lean back into the bar slightly, allowing for a more upright squat, while also placing more tension on the quads. If your heels are raising at the bottom, you may need to bring your feet more forward. If your feet feel like they are slipping or your lower back is rounding at the bottom, try bringing your feet back a bit.

Protocol Details:

  • Rest: 3-5 min
  • Warm-up Sets: 2-4

Substitution Options:

  • Dumbbell Single Leg Split Squat
  • Barbell Full Squat

Execution Notes:

To keep tension on the hamstrings, stop about 75% of the way to full lockout on each rep (i.e. stay in the bottom 3/4 of the range of motion).

Protocol Details:

  • Rest: 2-3 min
  • Warm-up Sets: 2-4

Substitution Options:

  • Dumbbell Straight-back Straight-leg Deadlift
  • Romanian Deadlift

Execution Notes:

Set the seat back as far as it will go while still feeling comfortable. Grab the handles as hard as you can to pull your butt down into the seat. Use a 2-3 second negative. Feel your quads pulling apart on the negative.

Protocol Details:

  • Rest: 1-2 min
  • Warm-up Sets: 1-2

Substitution Options:

  • Reverse Nordic
  • Sissy Squat

Execution Notes:

1-2 second pause at the bottom of each rep. Instead of just going up onto your toes, think about rolling your ankle back and forth on the balls of your feet.

Protocol Details:

  • Rest: 1-2 min
  • Warm-up Sets: 1-2

Substitution Options:

  • Lever Seated Calf Raise
  • Sled 45° Calf Raise (plate loaded)

Execution Notes:

Round your lower back as you crunch. Maintain a mind-muscle connection with your 6-pack.

Protocol Details:

  • Rest: 1-2 min
  • Warm-up Sets: 1

Substitution Options:

  • Weighted Incline Sit-up
  • Lever Seated Crunch

Execution Notes:

Do these pulldowns with the handle more out in front of you, more like a cross between pullover and a pulldown. Focus on feeling your lats working more than the weight you're using.

Protocol Details:

  • Rest: 2-3 min
  • Warm-up Sets: 2-3

Substitution Options:

  • Neutral-Grip Pull-Up
  • Cable Parallel Grip Pulldown

Execution Notes:

Flare elbows out at roughly 45° and squeeze your shoulder blades together hard at the top of each rep.

Protocol Details:

  • Rest: 2-3 min
  • Warm-up Sets: 2-3

Substitution Options:

  • Lever T-bar Row (plate loaded)
  • Dumbbell Lying Row

Execution Notes:

Focus on squeezing your shoulder blades together, driving your elbows down and back.

Protocol Details:

  • Rest: 2-3 min
  • Warm-up Sets: 1-2

Substitution Options:

  • Helms Row
  • Meadows Row

Execution Notes:

Pause for 1-2 seconds in the squeeze of each rep. Contract the rear delts hard!

Protocol Details:

  • Rest: 1-2 min
  • Warm-up Sets: 1-2

Substitution Options:

  • Cable Standing Rear Delt Row (with rope)
  • Lever Seated Reverse Fly (on pec deck)

Execution Notes:

Brief pause at the top of the bottom of ROM. Think about pulling your shoulders up to your ears!

Protocol Details:

  • Rest: 1-2 min
  • Warm-up Sets: 2-3

Substitution Options:

  • Cable Shrug (dual pulley)
  • Dumbbell Shrug

Execution Notes:

Set up the cable at the lowest position. Maintain constant tension on the biceps. Slow, controlled reps!

Protocol Details:

  • Rest: 1-2 min
  • Warm-up Sets: 1

Substitution Options:

  • Barbell Curl
  • Dumbbell Curl

Execution Notes:

Smooth, controlled reps. Mind-muscle connection with the biceps.

Protocol Details:

  • Rest: 1-2 min
  • Warm-up Sets: 1

Substitution Options:

  • Barbell Preacher Curl
  • Dumbbell Preacher Curl

Execution Notes:

Set up a comfortable arch, quick pause on the chest and explode up on each rep.

Protocol Details:

  • Rest: 3-5 min
  • Warm-up Sets: 2-4

Substitution Options:

  • Lever Chest Press
  • Dumbbell Bench Press

Execution Notes:

Ensure that your elbows break at least 90°. Mind-muscle connection with your delts. Smooth, controlled reps.

Protocol Details:

  • Rest: 2-3 min
  • Warm-up Sets: 2-3

Substitution Options:

  • Cable Shoulder Press
  • Dumbbell Shoulder Press

Execution Notes:

All reps and sets are to be performed in the bottom half of the ROM. Focus on feeling a deep stretch in your pecs at the bottom of each rep.

Protocol Details:

  • Rest: 1-2 min
  • Warm-up Sets: 1-2

Substitution Options:

  • Cable Seated Fly
  • Cable Standing Incline Fly

Execution Notes:

Protocol Details:

  • Rest: 1-2 min
  • Warm-up Sets: 1

Substitution Options:

  • Cable Triceps Extension (with rope)
  • Dumbbell Lying Triceps Extension

Execution Notes:

There are two ways you can do this: upright or bent over. Choose the one that feels more comfortable for you. The main thing is that when you're in the full squeeze, your shoulder should be positioned back behind your torso.

Protocol Details:

  • Rest: 1-2 min
  • Warm-up Sets: 1

Substitution Options:

  • Dumbbell Kickback
  • Bench Dip

Execution Notes:

Allow your lower back to round as you curl your legs up. 10-20 reps is a broad range on purpose: just go until you hit the listed RPE with controlled form.

Protocol Details:

  • Rest: 1-2 min
  • Warm-up Sets: 1-2

Substitution Options:

  • Hanging Leg Raise
  • Modified Candlestick

Execution Notes:

Feet lower on the platform for more quad focus. Get as deep as you can without excessive back rounding. Control the negative and do a slight pause at the bottom of each rep.

Protocol Details:

  • Rest: 2-3 min
  • Warm-up Sets: 2-4

Substitution Options:

  • Smith Rear Lunge
  • Dumbbell Walking Lunge

Execution Notes:

Lean forward over the machine to get a maximum stretch in your hamstrings.

  • Warm-up Sets: 1-2

Substitution Options:

  • Lever Lying Leg Curl
  • Nordic Ham Curl

Execution Notes:

Lower all the way down until your front thigh is parallel to the ground. Drive through your front heel on the way up.

  • Goblet Squat

Substitution Options:

  • Sissy Squat

Execution Notes:

Execution Notes:

If possible, use pads to increase the range of motion on the machine. Lean forward and grab onto the machine rails to stretch the glutes further.
